source_pr_title: feat(act): pending-watch marker for session-bound waits
author: kilo-code-bot
body:
**SUGGESTION:** Doc drift — marker filename is now `pr-pid-random.json`

The `WaitOptions.watch` JSDoc still says `<git-common-dir>/bro/watches/<pr>-<pid>.json`, but `watchBegin` now publishes a unique marker per wait: `<pr>-<pid>-<random>.json` (packages/act/src/pending-watch.ts:123-126), matching the spec's `pr-pid-random.json`. Two waits on the same PR in one process each own their marker, so a reader following this comment would expect a filename that can collide.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.
